meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 装上后，若你要求长期跟踪某个任务，Claude 会把它记成一个“目标”，并在你询问时汇报进展；只有在你要求完成并核对实际成果后，它才会把状态标成“完成”。暂停、恢复等其它操作通过 /goal 命令。
howto.when: 当你明确要求建立、查看进度或完成等管理长期目标时触发；若对话里已有进行中的目标，也会继续跟踪。暂停/恢复等操作走 /goal 命令。

say.text: 帮我记一个长期目标：一个月内读完三本专业书，预算两万 token。
say.note: Claude 会创建目标并写入预算。

say.text: 我们当前这个目标，进展到哪了？
say.note: Claude 会拉取当前目标并告诉你状态。

say.text: 我确认目标已全部完成，请核验后标成完成。
say.note: Claude 会逐项查证实际结果，无误后才标记完成。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude can hold a long-running task as a goal, report its progress on request, and only mark it complete after verifying real deliverables. Pause/resume and other state changes go through /goal commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to create, view progress on, or complete a long-running goal (or similar management requests); if an active goal already exists, Claude continues tracking it. Pause/resume are done via /goal commands.

say_en.text: Track a long-term goal for me: finish three books this month, with a 20k token budget.
say_en.note: Claude creates the goal with that budget.

say_en.text: What's the current progress on our goal?
say_en.note: Claude retrieves the goal and reports its status.

say_en.text: I confirm the goal is fully done; please verify and mark it complete.
say_en.note: Claude audits real results before marking complete.
